quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to fill your tummy before a busy day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: You do this before you leave for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good breakfast helps us focus and play all morning.
quests.funFact: Breakfast is often called the most important meal because it fuels your whole morning!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Morning to put on your clothes before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: Buttons, zippers, and sleeves are all part of this task.
quests.explanation: That's right! Getting dressed means changing out of pajamas into daytime clothes.
quests.funFact: Many schools have a favorite color or uniform that students wear when they get dressed!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to load up your bag with everything you need"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door for school.
quests.explanation: Well done! A packed backpack helps us feel ready for a great school day.
quests.funFact: Packing your backpack the night before can save you time in a busy morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to make your bed neat before you leave your room"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: It leaves your bed looking neat, ready for bedtime again later.
quests.explanation: Well done! A tidy bed helps our whole room feel neat and calm.
quests.funFact: Making your bed each morning is a small task that can make your whole room feel tidy!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Anytime to fill your cup and take a refreshing sip"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: You often do this after running or playing outside.
quests.explanation: Well done! Water is what our busy bodies need to stay healthy.
quests.funFact: Your body needs water to help you think, play, and grow every day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to sleep cozy and dream beautiful dreams"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: This is the very last thing you do before you fall asleep.
quests.explanation: That's right! Going to bed helps us get the sleep we need.
quests.funFact: Most children need about ten to twelve hours of sleep every single night!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to slip these onto your feet before your shoes"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: Your toes stay warm and cozy because of this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on socks comes right before putting on our shoes.
quests.funFact: Matching two socks together can be a fun little puzzle every morning!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning when the sun comes up and it's time to get moving"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: An alarm clock often helps remind your body it's time for this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Every morning begins the moment we wake up.
quests.funFact: Your body has its own natural clock that helps you wake up at the same time every day!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to wake up fresh and feel nice and clean"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: You do this right after you wake up, before you get dressed.
quests.explanation: That's right! Washing our face helps wake up our sleepy eyes.
quests.funFact: Washing your face gently helps keep your skin clean and healthy!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to splash in warm water and get squeaky clean"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: You do this before you put on your pajamas.
quests.explanation: That's right! A warm bath helps us relax before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Bath time is a great time to sing a silly song while you splash!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Midday to sit down and enjoy your favorite lunch"?
quests.question: Eat Lunch
quests.hint: This meal happens in the middle of the day, not the morning or night.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat lunch in the middle of the day to refuel.
quests.funFact: Lunchtime is a great time to chat and laugh with your friends!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to lace up before you leave the house"?
quests.question: Put on Shoes
quests.hint: You do this right before you walk out the door.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on our shoes before we head outside for the day.
quests.funFact: Wearing the right shoes helps keep your feet safe while you run and play!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to keep your toes warm and cozy all day"?
quests.question: Put on Socks
quests.hint: These go on your feet, right before your shoes.
quests.explanation: Yes! We put on socks to keep our feet warm before our shoes go on.
quests.funFact: Cozy socks can help keep your whole body feeling warm on a chilly day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to enjoy the last big meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Dinner
quests.hint: A warm plate of food is a clue for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! Eating dinner helps our body rest and refuel before bed.
quests.funFact: Sharing a meal together is a lovely time to talk about your favorite part of the day!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Anytime to quench your thirst after running and playing"?
quests.question: Drink Water
quests.hint: A cup or a bottle helps you do this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We drink water to keep our body cool and full of energy.
quests.funFact: Drinking water instead of sugary drinks is a great habit for a healthy body!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning and Night for a fresh, sparkly smile"?
quests.question: Brush Teeth
quests.hint: This keeps your smile sparkly and helps stop tiny tooth troubles.
quests.explanation: Correct! A clean smile starts with brushing our teeth every morning and night.
quests.funFact: Baby teeth need brushing too, even though new teeth will grow in later!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to smooth out your sheets and fluff your pillow"?
quests.question: Make Bed
quests.hint: Straightening blankets and lining up pillows are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Correct! We make our bed each morning right after we wake up.
quests.funFact: A neatly made bed is extra cozy and inviting when it's time to sleep again!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to snuggle under the covers and rest"?
quests.question: Go to Bed
quests.hint: A cozy pillow and a warm blanket are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Well done! A good night's sleep helps us grow strong and feel happy.
quests.funFact: Sleeping at night gives your busy body time to rest and grow strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to enjoy the very first meal of the day"?
quests.question: Eat Breakfast
quests.hint: It gives your body energy to run, play, and learn.
quests.explanation: Correct! Eating breakfast gives our body the fuel it needs to start the day.
quests.funFact: Eating a healthy breakfast can help you feel focused during your first class!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to splash away sleepy eyes with cool water"?
quests.question: Wash Face
quests.hint: It helps wake up your sleepy eyes.
quests.explanation: Well done! A splash of cool water is a great way to start the day.
quests.funFact: Cool water on your face can help you feel awake and alert in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Afternoon to recharge your energy with some quiet sleep"?
quests.question: Take a Nap
quests.hint: This sleep is shorter than your nighttime sleep.
quests.explanation: Yes! We take a nap in the afternoon to rest and recharge.
quests.funFact: A short nap can help you feel happier and more focused afterward!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Night to give a hug and share kind, cozy words"?
quests.question: Say Good Night
quests.hint: You say this just before the lights go off.
quests.explanation: Well done! We say good night to the people we love before bedtime.
quests.funFact: Saying good night with a hug or kind words can help you feel calm and happy before sleep!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Morning to smooth out any tangles from your pillow"?
quests.question: Comb Hair
quests.hint: This smooths out the tangles that happen while you sleep.
quests.explanation: Well done! A quick comb helps our hair look neat before school.
quests.funFact: Hair can get tangled while you sleep, so a morning comb helps smooth it out!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Morning to choose a shirt and pants for the day"?
quests.question: Get Dressed
quests.hint: This is when pajamas come off and daytime clothes go on.
quests.explanation: Well done! Getting dressed helps us feel ready for school or play.
quests.funFact: Laying out your clothes the night before can make getting dressed super fast in the morning!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to check you have books and pencils before you leave"?
quests.question: Pack Backpack
quests.hint: Books, pencils, and homework all go inside this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We pack our backpack in the morning so we're ready for school.
quests.funFact: A backpack with both straps on your shoulders is comfier to carry all day!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Anytime to keep sneaky germs from spreading to your food"?
quests.question: Wash Hands
quests.hint: Soap, water, and a good scrub are clues for this one.
quests.explanation: Yes! We wash our hands to keep sneaky germs away.
quests.funFact: Clean hands are one of the best ways to stay healthy and strong!

quests.instruction: Which routine task is done during: "Night to swap your daytime clothes for cozy sleep clothes"?
quests.question: Put on Pajamas
quests.hint: These clothes often have fun patterns like stars or stripes.
quests.explanation: Well done! Putting on pajamas helps us feel snug and ready for bed.
quests.funFact: Many pajamas are covered in fun patterns like stars, stripes, or favorite animals!

quests.instruction: Which daily task matches this clue: "Afternoon to have a little bite to keep your energy up"?
quests.question: Eat a Snack
quests.hint: This is smaller than a full meal, just a little bite.
quests.explanation: Yes! We eat a snack in the afternoon for a little extra energy.
quests.funFact: A small snack can help keep your tummy happy until dinner time!

quests.instruction: Which routine step fits: "Morning to stop dreaming and hop out of bed"?
quests.question: Wake Up
quests.hint: You do this before you even get out of bed.
quests.explanation: Correct! Waking up gets us ready for a whole day of learning and play.
quests.funFact: Getting enough sleep at night helps you wake up feeling happy and ready to play!

quests.instruction: What do we do for this: "Evening to wash away the whole day's dirt and dust"?
quests.question: Take a Bath
quests.hint: A rubber duck might float along while you do this.
quests.explanation: Well done! Taking a bath gets us squeaky clean from head to toe.
quests.funFact: Warm bath water can help your body relax and feel calm before bedtime!
